title: Assembly Hall of Shame
summary: A curated collection of notoriously bad assembly code examples that serves as an educational resource for developers learning x86 assembly programming by studying common mistakes and anti-patterns to avoid.
problem_solved: Provides concrete examples of what NOT to do when writing assembly code, helping developers recognize and avoid common pitfalls in low-level programming.
why_valuable: Learning from worst practices is an effective pedagogical approach that helps developers internalize best practices through cautionary examples rather than just theoretical guidance.
